range_convention: One-indexed inclusive line intervals. Source bytes are compared to the pinned git blob; the unnormalized bytes in each declared interval are hashed.

status_definitions.faithful_translation: A complete human proof of the precise cited source statement under its explicit application hypotheses.
status_definitions.derived_simplification: An explicitly proved shorter route to the exact required source assertion; any unused stronger scope is stated.
status_definitions.remaining_input: An explicitly identified specialized claim still requiring a human proof. No CG claim uses this status.

claims.title: Actual paired-path basis, saturation, and reduction of XX′
claims.statement: For any domain R, the source XX′ is the span of exactly the integral paired Psi basis indexed by segPairs. The normal-order projector keeps or kills each whole paired multidegree block. Therefore XX′ over O is saturated, its reduction is XX′ over the residue field, and total-letter-degree projection preserves it. This proves the first, third and sixth NestedTypeBound clauses used in the lift and RestLam.
assumptions: The previously reconstructed universal integral signed-path basis and exact simultaneous prefix filtration adaptation, IP3–IP4.
The source hypotheses valid frame, segN+r<=K and nonnegative integer margins are retained in application. The basis argument itself works without the latter two restrictions.
claims.source_relation: Direct proof of the needed three clauses from the common integral basis. The larger package fourth clause, a characteristic-zero joint-isotypic characterization, is neither assumed nor claimed here. Companion LA may use the actual saturation consequence.

claims.title: Literal coarse objects and Euclidean splitting of the coarse label
claims.statement: The source coarse generator and segment modules are preserved exactly. Unique late representatives modulo the period give ell=ell0+p^dist e, with fine label ell0 and every local exponent e<P_j. This yields the exact product identity for monomials. It needs no injection on an entire overlapping segment.
assumptions: Literal Dat.Hyp, defined in CG9 source references; all source natural-number subtractions and cutoffs are retained.
claims.source_relation: The terminal-frame exponent restriction in Mj remains in the definition but is not used by the congruence proof. Variables outside TT remain in ell0; the required final zero degrees outside TT are supplied by the actual homogeneous-generator condition.

claims.title: Determinant degree loss and exact coarse power scale
claims.statement: Every residue occurs at most twice in all segment letter sets, and each weighted determinant-row contribution is <=2a/(k²Y), giving E_t<=4Ns*a/(k²Y). The actual numerical hypotheses imply E_t<=a/40, E0<=a/32, a′>=0.9deg on TT and E<=d everywhere. With P_j=p^R_j, T_j>=4p(E0+mStar+1), P_j<=T_j<pP_j, P_j>mStar, and 8Yk²Ns*p^dist*P_j<=a.
assumptions: Ck>=32 and the literal frame/size hypotheses, including P1 and P3.
claims.source_relation: This is the same shared completed numerical result as RS2–RS3, whose elementary proof is recorded again for local readability; it is not an additional unproved interface. SD3 supplies nonvanishing separately and is not reproved.

claims.title: Internal coarse degrees and the oldest-letter dichotomy
claims.statement: A nonzero actual coarse generator has degree a′. An intermediate physical row occurs in only one segment, so a′=p^(dist+R)*b+label degree and the label bound yields b>a′/p^(dist+R)−k. The oldest of r vector predecessors of a late letter belongs either to the old frame or the intermediate set, exactly matching the two theta^c branches.
assumptions: The coarse product u is nonzero; the u=0 case is handled separately in CG8.
Each y_j has its declared whole-letter multidegree and satisfies the coarse allowed support.
claims.source_relation: The degree equality uses fixed multihomogeneity, not an unjustified assertion that arbitrary product monomials cannot cancel. The integer-row and residue uniqueness distinction is preserved.

claims.title: The complete threshold and normal-order numerical transfers
claims.statement: Both actual theta^c cases satisfy P_j(theta^c−kNs)>=theta. The proof uses c>=40kNs, q>=0.9c, b>q−k or floor(q)>q−1, retaining the old-frame offsets k+r+1 and m0=kNs+1. The oldest-letter gap gives P_j*o^c+kP_j<=o, with the exact source even/odd target constants10 and1.
assumptions: p>=13, k>=5, Ns,Y>=1, r<=k; all follow from literal Dat.Hyp.
claims.source_relation: The even case has an unused intermediate coefficient2 rather than10. The final theorem retains10 and changes no downstream source normalization.

claims.title: Canonical Frobenius product and all fine prefix and order bounds
claims.statement: For one allowed coarse paired path polynomial B=A0G0, reduction of D_j*expand_P(B)*X^e is A0^P*ellP*D_j times G0^P*ellN. Canonical coefficients lie in the prime field, so this identity is valid without inverse coefficient Frobenius. Signed label costs dS+dV<=kNsP and the individual determinant order s_x prove every fine gap, threshold and normal-order condition, with correct even/odd prefix indices and supports.
assumptions: The residue field has characteristic p; canonical path polynomials have integral coefficients by their literal wedge/contraction construction.
Local label e is late-supported and every exponent is <P_j.
claims.source_relation: The source four-premise wrapper is expanded into actual arithmetic and polynomial proofs. The general y expansion is coefficient-linear; no perfection of the residue field or false characteristic-zero Frobenius equivariance is used.

claims.title: Integral segment lift with the exact letter degree
claims.statement: Expand the coarse y in the allowed integral path basis, lift each canonical product by CG6 and CG1, and preserve the original scalar coefficients. The exact z_j degree is P_j*b plus label degree plus determinant-row occurrence degree. Projecting the integral lift onto this whole-letter degree preserves XX′ and the residue congruence, proving SegmentReductionLiftsMultihomogeneous.
assumptions: The segment y has its actual fixed whole-letter degree b.
claims.source_relation: The homogeneous-component argument is proved, not imported as an unexplained lifting theorem. A zero lift belongs to the prescribed homogeneous submodule and is allowed.

claims.title: Assembly into an individual allowed global generator
claims.statement: After the exact fine/coarse label splitting, form g=Z^ell0 product phi_j(x_j). Replacing each z_j by x_j of the same letter degree preserves the physical degree. Since Delta*u has degree E+a′=d and is nonzero when u is nonzero, g lies in the literal Gen set. Reduction commutes with products and substitutions, giving reduction(Delta*u)=reduction(g). The zero case uses the zero generator.
assumptions: SD3 gives Delta nonzero over the residue field and hence over O.
O is a domain, J>=1, and all supplied frame and numeric hypotheses are retained.
claims.source_relation: The conclusion is one element of Gen, not just a residue-span relation or a claimed member of the later chosen independent basis B_b. The nonzero and zero cases are both explicit.

claims.title: Exact closed theorem and remaining global scope
claims.statement: The reconstruction proves GeneratorModuloUniformiser(C0) for every C0>=32 under the literal UniformizedDVR and Dat.Hyp data, with CLa,Ck>=C0. It removes the coarse-generator congruence item of SD8. Quantitative coarse-family dimension, global frame/parameter supply and other global arithmetic and analytic inputs remain separate.
assumptions: Supplied actual Dat.Hyp / UniformizedDVR data; global existence is outside this local theorem.
claims.source_relation: No local specialized coarse-lifting premise remains unproved. The larger AdmB/NestedTypeBound conjunctions are not used as black boxes; only the precise needed clauses are reconstructed. No whole RH/GRH proof or kernel replay is asserted.
